title: G7 formal preflight accepted public source-task lineage mutation
evidence: Before repair, changing one formal source_task_id and synchronizing the affected label public hash still passed strict formal preflight with no case-set, family-set, or label-hash errors.
remediation: Freeze and enforce canonical SHA-256 identities for the exact public cases, private labels, and corrected retry plan; add an adversarial source-task mutation test.
